447869.overview:
A boss fight against a charming opponent!

Controls
Use the arrow keys to control your lil' bloop... that's it!

Goal
Defeat the boss by collecting glowing tiles without losing all your hearts.

448581.overview: The Adventures of Jelpi is a platform game for the PICO-8 featuring the console's mascot Jelpi as the main character.

452532.overview:
Someone tried to sacrifice your keyboard... Well, it didn't go well, some of the buttons don't work anymore! Now you are an always JUMP'N'SHOT MAN.

    Q - change palette (!!!)
    Arrows - move
    Tab - restart level
    Enter - secret menu that allows you to reset your progress
    Made for ludum dare 43 under 48h hours (more like 12 hours).
